selection: One alternative after fixed-template failure; same four reused exploratory montage windows, not a new holdout

rationale.corners: Multiple locally textured seed points reduce dependence on one fixed whole-glove appearance; no later detection or replenishment.
rationale.forward_backward: Reject points that fail a short round trip;1.5pixels is an engineering consistency tolerance, not an accuracy calibration.
rationale.photometric: Reject large local8-bit appearance differences;25gray-level error is conservative and fixed before alternative outputs.
rationale.robust_motion: Median translation with3pixel inliers avoids fitting an unstable affine map to a small changing glove region.
rationale.retention: Require6points plus60percent of previous and40percent of seed tracks; otherwise abstain instead of silently tracking a few survivors.
rationale.step_and_cut: Reject per-frame jumps above20pixels and global mean absolute difference above20percent; do not expand search or redetect.

reference_scope: Assistant visual estimates, unreviewed; compare final endpoint only when the entire frozen window completes. Abstentions are not endpoint successes or failures.
